title: Page and User TSconfig
hints: TSconfig here means TYPO3 page and user TSconfig, not the tsconfig.json of the TypeScript build. The two are unrelated and neither is a place to configure the other.
A system extension ships page TSconfig defaults in Configuration/page.tsconfig, auto-loaded from that path — there is nothing to register in ext_localconf.php.

hints.text: Configuration/user.tsconfig is auto-loaded the same way.

hints: An option is read from the merged page TSconfig. In FormEngine that merge is done by the PageTsConfigMerged data provider, so a provider that reads the option has to depend on it.
A new TSconfig option is user-facing configuration: it needs a Feature changelog entry and documentation, not just the default.
Behaviour that depends on TSconfig is covered by functional tests; the parser itself lives in typo3/sysext/core/Classes/TypoScript/.
